title: Verified provider market-data boundaries require stable supporting-evidence SHA-256 provenance
context: Provider evidence already required all seven market-data boundaries to be explicitly classified, but a boundary marked verified could participate in provider-side readiness with only free-text evidence. The machine gate could not distinguish a stable supporting artifact commitment from a prose-only assertion.

validation.honest_open_state_case: unknown boundary may omit evidence_sha256 and remains fail-closed

scope_note: This closes a credential-free boundary-provenance commitment gap only. It does not prove supporting artifact truth, licensing, completeness, provider permission, strategy profitability or holdout readiness.
